title: Your Story Matters
description: Introduce yourself, develop your why, and tell us how you work best.
softDueNote: Intro and why submissions are requested by {softDue}.
objectives: Articulate a personal "why" for teaching that connects to your values, experiences, and commitment to students.
Identify your learning preferences and professional context in ways that inform your development during the residency.
Introduce yourself to the KIPP DC community in a way that reflects both your identity and your purpose.

blocks.text: Your personal, educational, and professional history shapes how you see students, how you build relationships, and what you bring to a classroom.
Your reasons for choosing DC matter to this community.

sections.title: Help Us Get To Know You

blocks.text: Complete each submission using the button, then tick it off here.

items.label: Hometown Padlet
items.description: CTR Hometowns: drop a pin and add a post with your name and something you love about your hometown.

blocks.label: Watch: Teaching Is Heart Work (Teach For America)

blocks.text: Take a few minutes with each of these questions:

items: What do you want to be true for students?

blocks.prompt: Are any key themes emerging? Are there any words that you have an emotional response to or feel particularly drawn to?

blocks.text: A good why statement is simple, short, and easy to understand. It has no "whats" and is clear without further explanation.

blocks.prompt: Will this sustain me on a hard Tuesday in October?

blocks.text: Next, complete the Mentor Match survey. It asks about your feedback preferences, how you handle stress, your communication style, and your grade-band preference. Grade-band preferences are considered, but placement can't be promised.
